label: Female
summary: A yes/no value the game gives to the portrait customization rules: whether the portrait is female.
details: The rules' notes list it among the scopes an entry's `weight` can read, with `scope:culture`, `scope:current_weight`, `scope:weight_for_portrait` and `scope:prowess`; there is no root character, and `scope:ruler_designer` is always yes there. Vanilla's own script does not read it.

label: Firing
summary: A saved value named firing; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Firing court position
summary: A yes/no value the game gives when the AI weighs a court position: set and yes when the position is being fired, not set or no when it is being hired.
details: Vanilla reads it 5 times; the court position definitions check that it exists.

label: First
summary: The first thing an activity's pulse action saves to show it in the activity window; what it holds depends on the action.
details: Whatever a pulse action's effect saves as `scope:first` or `scope:second` can be shown in the activity's notice about the action. In the camp party actions, for example, it is one randomly picked adult attendee. Vanilla uses it 815 times, and each action saves its own thing.

label: Former designated diarch
summary: The character who was previously the designated diarch (the chosen co-ruler).
details: Vanilla reads it once, in the diarchy on_action file, where a comment describes it this way. The game documents nothing more.

label: Founder
summary: In great projects, the character who funded the project (or who would plan it); elsewhere a character the script saved.
details: The game itself gives it throughout great project types, next to `scope:owner` (who owns the project now) and `scope:founder_heir`. Vanilla also uses the name in other script (1,656 uses in all): a special building saves the holder of its county, and decisions save the character taking the decision.

label: Founder's heir
summary: The living heir of the character who funded a great project.
details: The game itself gives it in great project types, next to `scope:founder`. It can be empty when the founder has no living heir. While a project is still being planned it is the same character as the founder.

label: Friendly battle owner
summary: A saved value named friendly_battle_owner; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Friendly commander
summary: A battle commander; vanilla saves the side commander of a battle under this name.
details: Vanilla uses it 9 times, in artifact, legend spread and combat events. The game documents nothing more.

label: Game tutorial index
summary: A saved value named game_tutorial_index; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Gift
summary: Going by its name, a gift; vanilla saves a newly made artifact under it in an event, and an interaction tests it as a yes/no value.
details: Vanilla uses it 71 times. In the invite agent to scheme interaction the script only tests whether it exists (`always = scope:gift`). The game documents nothing more.

label: Glory
summary: Going by its name, a glory amount (accolade fame); vanilla uses it as a number.
details: Vanilla reads it 4 times, in the accolade on_actions and accolade scripted effects, where it is used as a value and added to something. The game documents nothing more.

label: Gold paid
summary: A saved value named gold_paid; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Gold received
summary: A saved value named gold_received; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Government
summary: Going by its name, a government (form of rule); vanilla reads it once, in a clothing trigger.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Government type
summary: Going by its name, a government type; vanilla reads it 24 times, in the grant title interaction and its rules.
details: The game documents nothing more.

label: Grand wedding promise
summary: Going by its name, the promise of a grand wedding made in a marriage interaction.
details: Vanilla reads it 5 times, in the marriage interactions and marriage interaction effects. The game documents nothing more.

label: Grant titles
summary: A saved value named grant_titles; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Granted
summary: A saved value named granted; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Great holy war
summary: Going by its name, the great holy war the script is about.
details: Vanilla reads it 41 times, for example in the religion on_actions and the religion GUI scripts. The game documents nothing more.

label: Great project
summary: The great project (a large building work that characters fund over time) that the script is about.
details: The game itself gives it throughout great project types, next to `scope:province` (where the project is). It is empty when the construction time is worked out before the project starts. Vanilla reads it 319 times, also in the China war casus belli.

label: Great project contribution
summary: Going by its name, a contribution made to a great project.
details: Vanilla reads it twice, in the TGP interactions. The game documents nothing more.

label: Great projects
summary: A saved value named great_projects; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Guest
summary: A guest character: in guest management, the guest (or possible guest) at a ruler's court being handled.
details: In courtier and guest management the game gives the guest under this name, and it is the root there too. Vanilla also saves guests of activities under it, for example in coronation events (442 uses in all).

label: Guests
summary: A saved value named guests; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Hard difficulty destiny character
summary: A character that vanilla saves under this name in the player select destiny on_actions.
details: Vanilla uses it once, in that file. The game documents nothing more about what it is for.

label: Has hostages
summary: A saved value named has_hostages; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Has personal MaA space
summary: Going by its name, whether a character has room for personal men-at-arms.
details: Vanilla reads it once, in the scripted rules file. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has slot with obligation
summary: A saved value named has_slot_with_obligation; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Heir
summary: A character, usually someone's heir; vanilla saves a heir under this name in several places.
details: Vanilla uses it very often (493 times). Examples: the player heir of an activity's host, the player heir of an interaction's recipient, a character's current heir. Whose heir it is depends on where it is saved. The game documents nothing more.

label: Highest available aptitude
summary: A number the game gives when the AI weighs hiring or firing for a court position: the highest aptitude among the available candidates, from 0 (terrible) to 4 (excellent).
details: Vanilla compares a candidate's `scope:employee_aptitude` with it. It reads it 11 times, in the court position types and an EP1 script values file.

label: Highest future danger value
summary: A number the game gives when the AI weighs a travel option: the highest danger on the route.
details: The game's notes say to compare it with `travel_safety`. Vanilla's own script does not read it.

label: Highest held title tier
summary: Going by its name, the tier of the highest title a character holds.
details: Vanilla reads it 13 times, in clothing triggers and TGP triggers. The game documents nothing more.

label: Holder
summary: The holder of a title; vanilla saves the holder of a county under this name in building files.
details: Vanilla uses it very often (1,377 times), for example in building files. Other files may save another title's holder. The game documents nothing more.

label: Holder candidate
summary: The candidate the current title holder backs in an election; the game gives it when an elector's vote is worked out.
details: Next to it are `scope:candidate` (the candidate being considered), `scope:holder` (the current holder) and `scope:title` (the title under election), with the elector as root. Vanilla reads it 41 times, in elective succession modifiers and the feudal elective succession.

label: Holding
summary: The place where an activity takes place; vanilla saves the activity's location under this name in a tournament event file.
details: Vanilla uses it twice, in the EP2 tournament events. The game documents nothing more.

label: Holy site
summary: A holy site; vanilla saves a barony that is a holy site under this name.
details: Vanilla uses it 31 times, for example in legends and inventory on_actions. The game documents nothing more.

label: Holy site type
summary: The type of holy site being created; the game gives it to the cost of creating a holy site.
details: Next to it are `scope:title` (the holy site's barony), `scope:faith` and `scope:artifacts` (the artifacts being enshrined). Vanilla reads it 3 times, in the religion on_actions and the scripted costs.

label: Home court
summary: A home court; vanilla saves a character's home court, or in some interactions the recipient or the actor, under this name.
details: Vanilla uses it 130 times, for example in the prison and BP2 interactions. A hostage's home court is saved in the prison interactions. The game documents nothing more.

label: Hook
summary: Going by its name, a hook (a hold over someone) used in an interaction.
details: Vanilla reads it 368 times, for example in the alliance and artifact interactions. The game documents nothing more.

label: Host
summary: The host of an activity; vanilla saves the activity's host under this name.
details: Vanilla uses it extremely often (7,590 times), mostly in activity type files such as camp party and chariot race. The game documents nothing more.

label: Hostage
summary: A hostage; vanilla saves a character under this name, for example the secondary actor or secondary recipient of an interaction.
details: Vanilla uses it 628 times, in interactions and childhood on_actions. The game documents nothing more.

label: House
summary: A dynasty house; vanilla saves a character's house (for example the recipient's) under this name.
details: Vanilla uses it 63 times, for example in debug and Japan interactions. The game documents nothing more.

label: House 1
summary: Going by its name, the first of two houses in a house relation.
details: Vanilla reads it twice, in the house relation types. The game documents nothing more.

label: House 2
summary: Going by its name, the second of two houses in a house relation.
details: Vanilla reads it twice, in the house relation types. The game documents nothing more.

label: House relation
summary: A saved value named house_relation; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Imprisoner
summary: Going by its name, the character who imprisons someone; vanilla saves a character under this name.
details: Vanilla uses it 267 times, in prison interactions and major decisions. The prison interactions save the acting character as the imprisoner. The game documents nothing more.

label: Independency
summary: A saved value named independency; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Index
summary: Going by its name, a counting position; vanilla compares it with the number 2 in the PAM script values.
details: Vanilla reads it twice. The game documents nothing more.

label: Inheritance
summary: A saved value named inheritance; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Innovation
summary: A saved value named innovation; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Innovation travel countdown
summary: A saved value named innovation_travel_countdown; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Inspiration
summary: The inspiration; the game gives it to every script of an inspiration type, where the root is the inspiration too.
details: Vanilla uses it 242 times, in the artifact custom texts and inspiration files. The artifact creation effects save the artifact's inspiration under it.

label: Inspiration owner
summary: The character who has an inspiration; the game gives it to every script of an inspiration type.
details: Vanilla uses it very often (1,715 times), for example in artifact features and artifact custom texts. The artifact creation effects save the current character as the owner when none is saved yet.

label: Inspiration sponsor
summary: The character who sponsors an inspiration; the game gives it to every script of an inspiration type.
details: Vanilla saves it temporarily in an interaction and reads it 123 times, in inspiration files and EP1 script values.

label: Interesting destiny character
summary: A character that vanilla saves under this name in the player select destiny on_actions.
details: Vanilla uses it 33 times, in that file. The game documents nothing more about what it is for.

label: Intermediary
summary: A go-between in an interaction; vanilla saves the liege of the actor, or of the recipient, under this name.
details: Vanilla uses it 88 times, in the diarch and EP3 interactions. The game documents nothing more.

label: Invalid
summary: Going by its name, a yes/no marker; vanilla tests it once, in the prison interactions.
details: There the interaction's validity check looks at `scope:invalid = yes`. The game documents nothing more.

label: Invalidated by script
summary: A saved value named invalidated_by_script; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.

label: Involved characters
summary: A saved value named involved_characters; the game documents nothing about it and vanilla never uses it.
